research_question: Can agentic multi-modal RAG improve 3GPP specification search/QA?
method: Ingestion: .docx parsing, release/series/spec/version metadata extraction, section-aware recursive chunking (Eq.1-2), LLM image/table descriptions embedded with [IMG_XXX] markers (Eq.3-4).
